title: Bar Tutni

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Shabbat 71a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.71a.6) and [Keritot 4b](https://www.sefaria.org/Keritot.4b.2), where Resh Lakish cites him by name.

Hyman reports that the Soncino printing of [Shabbat 71a](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.71a.6) reads Tovyani. This accounts for the old Yuchasin’s entry “Rav Tovyani, a student of Resh Lakish,” which Seder HaDorot says it could not locate. Hyman instead proposes the reading of Yuchasin HaShalem: “Bar Tovyani, whose student was Resh Lakish.”[^2]

notes.text: The first source unit prints א״ל, but Shabbat 71a explicitly has Resh Lakish reporting Bar Tutni. The old Yuchasin formulation calls Tovyani Resh Lakish’s pupil; Hyman’s final תלמידו ר״ל reverses this: Resh Lakish was his pupil.

The two linked Bavli passages have Resh Lakish transmitting the teaching. Shabbat names Bar Tutni, and Keritot names Bar Ta’utni. The [Bar Tutni entry in Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3540&lang=en) records both spellings. In his [Rav Tovyani entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1595&lang=en), Heilprin says he could not locate that name and suggests a copying error. The Soncino and Yuchasin readings here are reported by Hyman.
